now.title: X-Men '97
now.text: In episode 12, Scott and Jean help Nathan escape Apocalypse's followers in the future, then return to the 1990s.

proposed.text: In episode 12, Scott and Jean stay in 3960 A.D. with Nathan and are captured with him by Apocalypse's followers. Rescued by the other X-Men, they are sent back to the 1990s by Nathan.

changes.evidence: Wikipedia's episode 11 (Days of Past Future) summary: Cyclops and Jean decide to stay in the future with Nathan, 'but they are captured by Apocalypse's followers'; the other X-Men 'rescue Cyclops, Jean, and Nathan'. Episode 12 ends with Nathan using Ship's computer to send the future X-Men back to the 1990s. So Scott and Jean are captured with Nathan and rescued, not the ones who help him escape.
